name: How do I choose the right contractor for log home interior sealing?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for log home interior sealing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who has direct, hands-on experience with log and cabin refinishing rather than standard drywall painters who may use rigid caulk. Quality candidates should understand log movement, know how to install backer rod correctly, and work with elastomeric, wood-specific products. It is helpful to work with a general and finish contractor who also handles drywall, trim, and carpentry, because log homes frequently feature complex transitions between natural logs, framed partitions, and painted surfaces. Ask if the business owner directly oversees and works on the job site to ensure detailed finish standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced log refinishing contractor who understands timber movement, uses specialized elastomeric products, and provides hands-on job supervision.
